This channel is dedicated to veterinary dermatology, animal skin health, allergy diagnosis, and dermatological research. 
This channel is managed by Dr. Sneh Lata, M.V.Sc., Ph.D., Scientist, Skin Disease Laboratory, Veterinary Clinical Complex (VCC), COVS, LUVAS, Hisar, Haryana, India. 
It provides educational content for veterinarians, veterinary students, researchers, pet owners, and livestock owners interested in the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of skin diseases in animals. The topics covered include skin scraping and trichography, fungal, bacterial, parasitic, and allergic skin diseases, canine atopic dermatitis, clinical case discussions and treatment protocols, veterinary dermatology research and laboratory techniques, and One Health aspects of zoonotic skin diseases. Our goal is to promote evidence-based veterinary dermatology through education, research, and clinical expertise.
